meta.title: Mass Flow Converter — Convert Kilogram/second and More
meta.description: Free mass flow converter for 7+ units including Kilogram/second, Kilogram/minute, Kilogram/hour. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: kg/s, kg/h, lb/h, ton/h. Convert between 7 mass flow units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for mass flow in this tool is **kgs**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most mass flow conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Kilogram/second | kg/s |
| Kilogram/minute | kg/min |
| Kilogram/hour | kg/h |
| Gram/second | g/s |
| Pound/second | lb/s |
| Pound/hour | lb/h |
| Ton/hour (metric) | t/h |
content.use_cases:
- Recipe scaling and bartending where measures span metric and imperial.
- Fuel economy comparisons across regions.
- Lab dosing and reagent prep across mL, L, and US/UK units.
- Aquarium, pool, and tank capacity calculations.
- Shipping fluid product specs across markets.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this mass flow converter?
**A:** It uses 7 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Kilogram/second (kg/s), Kilogram/minute (kg/min), Kilogram/hour (kg/h), Gram/second (g/s), Pound/second (lb/s), Pound/hour (lb/h), Ton/hour (metric) (t/h).
